title: Out-of-Network Service Allowances, KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
Whether a KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans visit may be done at a licensed facility outside the Kestrel network and reimbursed, how much one such visit can be reimbursed, how many such visits a plan allows and the time limits that apply, by plan level.

## Allowance schedule

| Plan level | Out-of-network visit allowed | Maximum reimbursed for one out-of-network visit (USD) | Maximum out-of-network visits over the plan | Calendar days after the service date to submit the repair order | Business days after approval within which the reimbursement is paid |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Starter | No | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 10 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Basic | Yes | 89.99 | 1 | 30 | 10 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | Yes | 99.99 | 1 | 30 | 10 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Plus | Yes | 109.99 | 2 | 30 | 10 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier | Yes | 119.99 | 2 | 30 | 10 |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max | Yes | 129.99 | 3 | 30 | 10 |

## Reading the schedule

- **KestrelCare Maintenance Starter** does not allow out-of-network visits; its cap of 0.00, its maximum of 0 visits and its submission period of 0 days reflect that.
- **The cap** is a maximum per visit, not an allowance per plan: a KestrelCare Maintenance Plus plan, for instance, can be reimbursed up to 109.99 for each of its 2 out-of-network visits.
- **The submission period** is counted in calendar days after the service date shown on the repair order; **the payment period** is counted in business days after approval.

## Hypothetical comparison

For an example holder, a KestrelCare Maintenance Basic plan allows 1 out-of-network visit with a cap of 89.99, while a KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max plan allows 3 such visits with a cap of 129.99 each; on both, the repair order is submitted within 30 calendar days after the service date and an approved reimbursement is paid within 10 business days.
